text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... When did it get so dark? I guess
there's no one left doing
overnight prep?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: So it really is... just me.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Grrr, that's fine! I'm gonna see Windy's
Demonic Castle on to its
glorious
completion! For sure!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(I mean, I was so happy when we were all
giving it everything.)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
First Digital and Doto, then Palmer and
Helios... Seeing all of the
members of my
legion slowly come together was so
amazing...)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: (And then she said...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The Demon Queen herself taught us
something very important.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's right, I'm the illustrious Demon
Queen, and my subjects admire
me so!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll do this. I'll make sure that all who step
foot into my lair feel the
dreadliest of
dread!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to see the looks on my underlings' faces tomorrow. Now this is an actual prank!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clip-clap, clip-clap...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Eek! What's that sound? Don't tell me... A
ghost?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
C-come no closer! I need some kinda
weapon!

text_block_list.name: Monster?
text_block_list.text: Goood eveniiing?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Gyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Urrghhhgh! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huuuh? Digitaaal!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uwah, it's just us, Windy! I'm sorry for
startling you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Doto! Eh, then the person I just walloped...
Digital?! H-hey, wake up!
Open your eyes,
Digital!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Your wish is my commaaand!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wait, just like that?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, verily, I am the undying jiangshi
Digitan, one of Demon
Queen Windy's
four divine generals!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And one of your loyal followers.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: So please hear my plea, my liege!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Please allow us to help you complete the
castle!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sure we can be of some assistance!
Please, my liege!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: D-Digital, Doto...

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
I knew I'd seen that lantern before. It goes
so well with your costume,
Doto.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Dang, there sure are a lot of us. Maybe we
should go apply for
permission to stay the
night.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: E-everyone! When did you—

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Well you see, we couldn't really sleep, you
know? Guess we were all
hyped up over
building the castle.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
We knew there was just a bit more work to
be done, so... can we help
out too, Windy?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oooh, you guys...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
HMPH! You really are all just hopeless!
You'd best praise my
benevolence!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Right, let us get started then!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Sniff... Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, can't we make the Demon Queen's
outfit even more outrageous?
She's the
very last scare, after all.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, maybe we can add some horns or
something? I could probably
whip
something up with some paper-mache!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, heck yeah! I'd definitely look even
cooler with some horns! Do it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(And shortly, the sun broke forth from
beneath the horizon.)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Mornin'! Anything left to help with?
Training's got me PUMPED!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Sorry we couldn't be of any help lately!
Wait... Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Witness the birth of the
devilishly demonic Queen
Windy!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Slay, Queen! Serving nothing but the most
wicked of vibes! Love ya,
my liege!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So cool, Windy! I'm gagged!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hehe, hahahaha! Keep the praises coming!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, if Windy's happy with it, then so am
I!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
To witness the Demon Queen bask in the
morning glow! I know that I
will be revived
endlessly, without fail!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, so the morning did glow. The Solefall
Faire was finally upon us,
which meant my
time with my friends was approaching its
end. And
knowing that alone made me
feel a bit...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (Lonely.)
